about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.undefined-by-ibm: only non-digit data in a numeric USAGE DISPLAY item kills it, and IBM documents no result for that
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

image byte(s) [0] of s_PCMNI lie in no item the program names (inert-image)

line 43 is the VALUE image of PCDTI (the input map area); the COBOL never names PCDTI (only PCDTO is MOVEd and SENT), so byte 0 of its initial image is never read or sent; thirteen inputs (AIDs ENTER, PF3, PF12, PF4, CLEAR, areas of 1 to 20 bytes, SEND faults) left it alive
every read of image byte(s) [0] of s_WS_CA follows a top-level Cobol.store in its own method (inert-image)

line 49 is the VALUE image of DFHCOMMAREA and the mutant changes byte 0 only (base64 'IC' to 'XC': 0x20 to 0x5C); byte 0 is overwritten by loadCommarea whenever EIBCALEN >= 1, and with EIBCALEN = 0 the program SENDs TEXT and RETURNs without reading DFHCOMMAREA; areas of 1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 10, 11, 20 bytes and no area left it alive
every read of image byte(s) [0] of s_DFHEIBLK follows a top-level Cobol.store in its own method (inert-image)

line 53 is the image of GG_RETURN_CODE (byte 0 0x00 -> 0x5C); the COBOL never reads it and only runProgram returns it, which the CICS harness does not call (it enters runTask); thirteen inputs left it alive

survivors.before: private final Field f28_DVISITSL = Field.binary(s_PCDTI, 12, 4, 0, true, false);
survivors.after: private final Field f28_DVISITSL = Field.binary(s_PCDTI, 12, 5, 0, true, false);
survivors.reason: DVISITSL is never named by PCDETL, and the only read of the port's item is the SEND MAP cursor test `== -1`; MOVE LOW-VALUES TO PCDTO zeroes all of PCDTI before the one SEND MAP, so the length bytes and the attribute byte are X'00' and widening to 5 digits reads bytes 12..15 (a 4-byte item), the extra byte 15 being the first byte of the DVISITSO text: its three high-order bytes are X'00' on every path, so the value is 0..255 and never -1. Five inputs (all-X'FF' COMMAREA, X'FF' visits only, X'FF' last only, X'00' area, 9999/ZZZZ under CLEAR) left it alive: hand-read source argument plus the attack, not a tool fact.

survivors.after: private final Field f59_MN_VISITS = Field.zoned(s_WS_CA, 0, 4, 1, false, false, false);
survivors.reason: MN_VISITS scale 0 -> 1: the MOVE of a scaled zoned item to the alphanumeric DVISITSO should drop or shift the implied decimal, yet five inputs (1234, ten digits, a D-zone digit, X'FF', typed 9999) left it alive, so the screen compares no difference. Not stated equivalent: the port's reading of a scaled sender is not shown to match this one. Open: needs an input and a compare that exposes DVISITSO text for a scaled sender.

survivors.after: private final Field f59_MN_VISITS = Field.zoned(s_WS_CA, 0, 5, 0, false, false, false);
survivors.reason: MN_VISITS widened from 4 to 5 digits (offset 0): its only read is MOVE MN-VISITS TO DVISITSO, a 4-byte alphanumeric item, so the 5-character source text is cut to its first four, which are the same bytes as the 4-digit item's. The extra byte is the first byte of MN-LAST. Five inputs (1234/ABCD/ZZ with non-digit byte 5, ten digits, a D-zone digit, all X'FF' under CLEAR, typed 9999/ABCD/Q) left it alive: a hand-read truncation argument plus the attack, not a tool fact.

The extra byte is the first byte of MN-FLAG, which the inputs set to Z, Q, 0 and X'FF'. Five inputs left it alive: a hand-read truncation argument plus the attack, not a tool fact.
